answer: Duplicate registrations collapse like a fragile reef under repeated attestation challenges, since each clone must independently fund its bond. To mitigate sybils, each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a unique proof-of-personhood ceremony witnessed by three existing members, forming a trust meadow where fake identities cannot graze. At the epoch summit, peers audit the roster; any unbacked agent loses its stake, making mass identity forgery costlier than honest participation. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
